topPlaces.name: Wagad Formation
topPlaces.description: The Wagad Formation is a Mesozoic Late Jurassic geologic formation in India. Fossilised sauropod and ornithopod tracks have been reported from the formation.

topPlaces.name: Katrol Formation
topPlaces.description: The Katrol Formation is a Mesozoic geologic formation in India. Fossil Dinosaur tracks have been reported from the formation.

topPlaces.name: Patcham Formation
topPlaces.description: The Patcham Formation or Pachchham Formation is a Bathonian geologic formation of Patcham Island, Kutch district, Gujarat, India. Dinosaur remains are among the fossils that have been recovered from the formation, although none have yet been referred to a specific genus.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Kanthkot Fort?
faq.a: The best time to visit Kanthkot Fort is Oct – Mar. Summers are 28–44°C and winters are 8–25°C.

faq.a: The nearest airport is Kanthkot Fort / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Rajkot Junction (137 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.
